answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lotus. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
